about.intro_content: Prof. Xiao-Jun Lin is a Professor in the Department of Pancreaticobiliary Surgery at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center (SYSUCC), Guangzhou, treating liver, gallbladder and pancreatic cancer.
about.detailed_content: Prof. Lin's research includes a global epidemiological analysis of the burden, trends and inequalities of gallbladder and biliary tract cancer from 1990–2021, published in Liver International. He has also researched PD-L1 expression on tumour-infiltrating immune cells and the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio as predictive biomarkers for immunotherapy outcomes following biliary tract cancer recurrence, based on a cohort of 239 patients treated at SYSUCC's Department of Pancreaticobiliary Surgery.

items.question: Does Prof. Xiao-Jun Lin accept international patients?
items.answer: CancerFax can coordinate medical report review and consultation support for international patients seeking an opinion related to liver, gallbladder or pancreatic cancer at Sun Yat-sen University Cancer Center, subject to hospital availability and case acceptance.

items.question: What is Prof. Lin's area of specialisation?
items.answer: Prof. Lin specialises in the surgical treatment of liver, gallbladder, biliary tract and pancreatic cancer.

items.question: How can I request a consultation or second opinion?
items.answer: Submit your medical reports through CancerFax. The CancerFax team reviews the documents, prepares the case for submission, and coordinates next steps with SYSUCC's International Medical Center, subject to availability.

items.question: Has Prof. Lin researched immunotherapy for biliary tract cancer?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Lin has studied PD-L1 expression and the neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio as predictive biomarkers for immunotherapy outcomes in patients with recurrent biliary tract cancer.

items.question: Has Prof. Lin contributed to global cancer research?
items.answer: Yes. Prof. Lin co-authored a global analysis of the burden and trends of gallbladder and biliary tract cancer from 1990 to 2021, published in Liver International.
